title: Sidewalk extension area

blocks.html: All developments which are located on a zoning lot with frontage along Emmons Avenue, Sheepshead Bay Road, Ocean Avenue, Bedford Avenue or Nostrand Avenue shall contain a sidewalk extension area, which complies with the following requirements:
blocks.plainText: All developments which are located on a zoning lot with frontage along Emmons Avenue, Sheepshead Bay Road, Ocean Avenue, Bedford Avenue or Nostrand Avenue shall contain a sidewalk extension area, which complies with the following requirements:

blocks.html: (a)        has a minimum depth of five feet, measured perpendicular to such street lines;
blocks.plainText: (a) has a minimum depth of five feet, measured perpendicular to such street lines;

blocks.html: (b)        extends the full length of the zoning lot along such street lines, except for existing buildings within five feet of the street line;
blocks.plainText: (b) extends the full length of the zoning lot along such street lines, except for existing buildings within five feet of the street line;

blocks.html: (c)        is open and unobstructed from its lowest level to the sky;
blocks.plainText: (c) is open and unobstructed from its lowest level to the sky;

blocks.html: (d)        maintains continuity with the established sidewalk, to which it shall be immediately adjacent throughout its entire length;
blocks.plainText: (d) maintains continuity with the established sidewalk, to which it shall be immediately adjacent throughout its entire length;

blocks.html: (e)        is available for public use at all times; and
blocks.plainText: (e) is available for public use at all times; and

blocks.html: (f)        has a paved surface which complies with standards as established by the New York City Department of Transportation.
blocks.plainText: (f) has a paved surface which complies with standards as established by the New York City Department of Transportation.

blocks.html: No sidewalk extension area shall be required along any portion of a street line where a plaza is provided in accordance with the provisions of Sections 94-072 (Special plaza provisions) or 94-081 (Plaza bonus).
blocks.plainText: No sidewalk extension area shall be required along any portion of a street line where a plaza is provided in accordance with the provisions of Sections 94-072 (Special plaza provisions) or 94-081 (Plaza bonus).
